device.description: original-style Konix DC02, one tested unit

scope.measurement: PreSonus Studio 68c analog capture, effects on USB-triggered notes unless stated
scope.notes: No detected effect is conditional on the tested patch, values and message sequence.

polyphony.scope: Single patch and channel. Cross-channel voice pool unmeasured.

1.name: modulation
1.effect: Increases cyclic pitch variation with the controller value.

5.name: portamento_time
5.effect: Controls glide with CC65 on and preceding C3.

10.name: pan
10.effect: Both recorded inputs decreased about 3 dB at either endpoint. Stereo placement is unverified.

65.name: portamento_switch
65.effect: CC65 0/127/0 at CC5=64 toggled off/on/off on each program.

75.name: decay
75.effect: No repeatable envelope or level response.

76.name: vibrato_rate
76.effect: With CC77=127, CC76 changes the oscillation pattern across all three tested programs.

77.name: vibrato_depth
77.effect: Value 127 increases cyclic pitch variation with CC1=0.

78.name: vibrato_delay
78.effect: With CC77=127, value 127 delayed observable vibrato beyond the measured held-note window.

91.name: reverb_send
91.effect: Longer release tail with increased send.

93.name: chorus_send
93.effect: Isolated repeat with reverb send off gave no repeatable change.

0.name: bank_select_msb
0.effect: Tested with CC32 and program changes.

7.name: volume
7.effect: At program 0, 32 versus 85 differed by approximately 17.4 dB.

11.name: expression
11.effect: Program 0 held note rose approximately 20.5 dB.

32.name: bank_select_lsb
32.effect: Programs 0–9 in banks 0/0, 0/1 and 1/0 were substantially equivalent.

64.name: sustain
64.effect: Note remained audible after Note Off until pedal release.
